run_encoder_training: run the encoder training CLI with --data, --g_ckpt, --outdir, --max_steps, --batch, and --lr options
create_vggloss: create a VGGLoss module using pretrained VGG19 features to compute perceptual L1 loss between source and target images
run_d_logistic_loss: run the discriminator logistic loss calculation combining softplus losses for real and fake predictions
run_d_r1_loss: run the R1 gradient penalty loss by computing the squared gradient norm of real predictions w.r.t. real images
run_g_nonsaturating_loss: run the generator nonsaturating loss using softplus on negative fake predictions for GAN training
